articles.title: Public hearings scheduled in Ameren electric rate increase case
articles.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) The Public Service Commission announced in a Tuesday press release that public hearings have been scheduled in Ameren’s electric rate increase request case. Ameren filed tariff sheets with the PSC on June 26 “seeking a net increase in annual electric base rate revenues of approximately $343 million,” or about $13 per month

articles.title: Person dead after collision with utility truck in Peoria County
articles.description: A 37-year-old Chillicothe woman died after her vehicle struck a parked Ameren utility truck and caught fire.
articles.content:
A 37-year-old Chillicothe woman was killed in a fiery vehicle crash Sunday night.
The woman's vehicle struck the rear of a parked Ameren utility truck that was performing maintenance.

articles.title: Utica solar farm to go live late summer 2027, offering Ameren customers 15% savings
articles.description: Utica Solar is a 6.7-megawatt project being built, owned and operated by Nexamp, a company founded in 2007 by two U.S. Army Veterans. The site, just west of Route 178, is about 28 acres of fenced farmland that will hold just over 10,000 American-made solar panels.
articles.content:
